definition.en: Documented agreements that define the services to be delivered and measurable expectations such as availability, support, security, response times, and responsibilities.
definition.nl: Gedocumenteerde overeenkomsten waarin de te leveren diensten en meetbare verwachtingen zijn vastgelegd, zoals beschikbaarheid, ondersteuning, beveiliging, responstijden en verantwoordelijkheden.

en: Use for policies, requirements or practices specifically concerning service-level agreements. Use the broader concept for statements that do not distinguish this specific aspect.
